title: Trading Cuts For Clicks: New Software Performs 'Virtual Surgery' | ScienceDaily
description: A new software tool developed by computer scientists at Brigham Young University will allow surgeons to instantly visualize any part of a patient's anatomy by extracting a 3-D computer image from an MRI, CT scan or similar data with just a few clicks of the mouse.
